commands.name: config-discover
commands.summary: List project configuration domains and exact projects
commands.description: Lists the registered configuration domains and the exact project names that can be queried or authored. Read-only; validates nothing. Output is JSON with --json.

commands.name: config-get
commands.description: Resolves one domain for one project (exact package name) through its rig, inheritance and suppression chain and prints the effective document. Read-only; exit 2 when the project or domain is unknown or the document is invalid.

commands.name: config-explain
commands.description: Shows where every field of a project's effective document comes from (local, inherited, rig, suppressed) so a value can be traced to the file that set it. Read-only.

commands.name: config-validate
commands.description: Validates every registered document offline against the pinned schemas and the applicability policy. Read-only; exit 2 lists every failing file with a diagnostic code.

commands.name: config-preview
commands.summary: Preview project configuration edits without writing
commands.description: Turns a request file of edits into a plan: the exact bytes each target file would receive, with diagnostics. Writes nothing; the plan is the only input config-apply accepts.

commands.name: config-apply
commands.summary: Apply a previously validated edit plan
commands.description: Applies a plan produced by config-preview as a whole (no subset selection) after re-checking that no input has changed since the preview. Each file is written atomically; a late failure stops later writes and leaves earlier ones in place, reported as a partial result (exit 4). Journals every write under common/temp; exit 3 when the preview is stale.

commands.name: config-status
commands.summary: Inspect an authoring journal without modifying files
commands.description: Reports the state of a journaled apply operation (applied, pending, unknown per target; lock owner; staged temporaries) for reconciliation after an interruption. Read-only; never deletes a lock or a file.

commands.name: config-init
commands.summary: Plan creation of a project configuration document without writing
commands.description: Previews the creation of a project's local document for a domain from a document file; refuses to overwrite an existing document. Produces a plan for config-apply.

commands.name: config-set
commands.summary: Plan a project configuration value assignment without writing
commands.description: Previews assigning a value at a JSON pointer in a project's local document. Produces a plan for config-apply; never edits inherited or rig sources.

commands.name: config-unset
commands.summary: Plan removal of a project configuration value without writing
commands.description: Previews removing a locally authored field at a JSON pointer; inherited values can reappear. An absent local field is a no-op with a note.

commands.name: config-suppress
commands.summary: Plan suppression of an inherited project configuration value without writing
commands.description: Previews suppressing an inherited value at a JSON pointer so it does not apply to this project; suppression is explicit and reversible, not deletion of the shared source.

commands.name: config-remove-suppression
commands.summary: Plan removal of a project configuration suppression without writing
commands.description: Previews removing a suppression so the inherited value applies again. No-op with a note when nothing is suppressed at the pointer.

commands.name: config-set-version
commands.summary: Plan a project configuration contract version change without writing
commands.description: Previews changing the declared schema version of a project's local document; the document is re-validated against the target version in the plan.
